title: Aouda declaration (aouda.json), version 1
description: aouda.json: what exists and who may do what, read by the server named by Aouda:Declaration (--declaration).

$schema.description: The JSON schema of this file, for an editor; the server ignores it and never fetches it.

version.description: The grammar's version. Required; 1 is the only one.

databases.description: The declared databases, keyed by database name.

additionalProperties.description: One declared database: created when missing and converged at every start; its name is the member's name.

kind.description: data (an ordinary database) or auth (an application auth database). Required.

authDatabase.description: data only: the application auth database this database is linked to.

schema.description: data only: the schema file applied at start, relative to this file's directory (or absolute). Its overlay for Aouda:Environment E is <stem>.E.json beside it.

schemaAllowDestructive.description: With schema: whether the start-time apply may drop tables and columns (default false; never on reload).

durability.description: strict (the default), os, unlogged or memory. An auth database is always strict.

writeConcernTimeoutMs.description: Milliseconds to wait for the write concern's acknowledgements; at least 100 (default 5000).

memoryWeight.description: Relative weight of this database's memory share; positive (default 1).

maxMemoryShareBytes.description: Cap on the computed memory share, in bytes (default: none).

roles.description: auth only: custom roles, keyed by role name.

additionalProperties.description: A custom role of this auth database: created when missing and converged at every start and reload; a role not declared is never touched.

items.description: One permission of a declared role, in the shape of the roles API.

resourceType.description: table (the default), all-partitions, all-rows or embargo.

actions.description: For a table row a comma-separated action list (default read); for an all-* grant exactly one level.
